decisions.reason: The portfolio count is a separate clause already represented by its own same-message MODIFY; changing the brochure count does not alter the portfolio Requirement.
The brochure quantity change does not alter the collateral's visual treatment, design basis, text density, or visual impact.
The source does not change the business-pitch content or image requirement.
Social-media content is independently introduced by another clause in the same message; the brochure count change does not modify that Requirement.
